articles.title: India bonds rise as oil shrugs off US sanctions concerns
articles.description: On Tuesday, Indian government bonds experienced a positive turn as oil prices fell sharply, reducing inflation worries among investors. The successful state debt auction further bolstered market confidence. Despite new U.S. sanctions on Iran, traders stayed vigilant regarding potential supply issues in the oil sector. Throughout the day, strong liquidity levels contributed to resilience in the debt market.

articles.title: Wall Street points to gains as US raises pressure on Iran and trade war with Canada intensifies
articles.description: Wall Street is poised to open with gains and oil prices fell as the U.S. announced new sanctions against Iran, while trade talks between American and Canadian officials hit a wall. Futures for the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average each rose 0.4% before the bell Tuesday, while Nasdaq futures jumped 0.8%. Chip giant Nvidia, one of the biggest beneficiaries of the AI boom, will deliver its quarterly earnings report on Wednesday. Its shares were up less than 1% in premarket trading Tuesday as it tries to break a 7-session losing streak.
